claims.summary: Medical consensus and peer-reviewed oncology studies confirm that consuming lemon water or boiled citrus peels cannot cure cancer.
claims.why_this_result: Oncological clinical research from WHO, NIH, and American Cancer Society shows no food or citrus extract eliminates malignant tumors in humans.

claims.summary: Chlorine dioxide and industrial bleaching agents are toxic corrosives that cause severe respiratory and gastrointestinal poisoning.
claims.why_this_result: FDA and global health regulatory agencies have issued emergency warnings classifying MMS as industrial bleach without medical efficacy.

claims.summary: Vaccine ingredients are publicly audited and analyzed using spectrometry and biochemical sequencing; zero electronic components exist in vaccines.
claims.why_this_result: Physical and micro-engineering constraints make sub-micron RFID chips in injectable liquids scientifically impossible and non-existent.

claims.summary: Diabetes mellitus is a chronic metabolic condition governed by insulin production and cellular resistance; no verified substance cures it overnight.
claims.why_this_result: Endocrinological science confirms diabetes requires systematic clinical management through diet, insulin therapy, or glucose-regulating medications.
